classification.category: numerical kinematic-parameter roundoff at configured domain boundary; not CFL, geometry inconsistency, or evidence corruption
classification.cause: strict powervalve-map domain check rejects stage RPM reconstructed from delta-angle and timestep when floating-point roundoff puts the endpoint a fraction outside the inclusive map bounds
classification.failure_reason: RPM is outside the configured powervalve map

reproduction: Read-only diagnostic instantiated IntegratedEngine2T from each preregistered fixture configuration and advanced only the affected short trajectory with the existing registered stepper; wrapped PowerValve.at to capture the rejected stage RPM and angle. No campaign runner, result writer, checkpoint writer, or artifact mutation was used.

scope_assessment.current_fixture_configuration: Map endpoints are explicitly [1000.0, 5000.0] in both A and B fixtures and preregistration; requested RPMs are exactly those endpoints.
scope_assessment.generalizability: Any engine/configuration whose powervalve map boundary equals the requested operating RPM can encounter the same floating-point endpoint excursion; risk depends on step arithmetic and mapped component use.
scope_assessment.identity_impact: Any implementation change alters solver/producer identity. It must be versioned and preregistered before a future campaign; historical IMPL2 results remain unchanged. No campaign rerun is authorized by this diagnostic.
scope_assessment.localized_fix_candidate: Preserve the exact configured operating RPM when resolving geometry, or snap to a map endpoint only when the excursion is within a rigorously bounded floating-point ULP tolerance; continue rejecting values materially outside the domain. Add boundary and just-outside tests.
scope_assessment.physical_model_error: Not indicated by this evidence; the map values and RPM requests are in-domain in the real-number contract.
